messages:
anya: Quick heads-up: found an odd interaction in errref where our 429 guidance for batch embeddings doesn't mention KV-cache collisions. Opening a small PR to add a short troubleshooting section and updated snippets.

sam: Nice catch. Can you summarize the user-visible symptom?

anya: Symptoms: occasional 429s during large embedding batches when prefix caching triggers duplicate cache keys; clients retry immediately which amplifies load. Docs should: 1) recommend jittered backoff + respect Retry-After, 2) suggest enabling per-client dedupe or cache namespace, 3) show a tiny batch example that reads Retry-After and yields gracefully.

jess: UX wise, we should add a one-line note in the errref top summary and a short "When you see this" troubleshooting block. Keep the language prescriptive.

mike: For snippets I can update Python and Go batch examples. Prefer showing exponential backoff with capped jitter and honoring Retry-After header when present. Also add a short code comment about not re-sending identical chunk IDs.

kevin: Can we add a small migration tip for Dedicated customers with KV-caching on the edge? They sometimes run a separate cache cluster and need to ensure consistent namespace across replicas.

doc-bot: Link-scan: 1 broken anchor in /errref/embeddings.md (line ~210). Snippet validator: expects marker <!-- SNIPPET: embeddings-batch --> in file.

anya: I'll include the marker and fix the anchor. Draft pseudo-snippet for the errref troubleshooting block:
```js
// batch loop (pseudo)
for (chunk of chunks) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { body: chunk })
  if (res.status === 429) {
    const ra = res.headers.get('retry-after') || '1'
    await sleep(parseInt(ra,10)*1000 + jitter())
    continue
  }
}
```
I'll also add a note: "If retries don't help, consider reducing batch size or enabling per-client cache namespaces."

sam: Add a checklist in the PR: run link-checker, run snippets:validate, run the small smoke script that asserts header presence for 429. Tag me when done and I'll prioritize review.

jess: I'll review copy after PR lands. Keep the troubleshooting block short and action-focused.

anya: Great  PR in ~30m, tagging @mike @kevin. Will add the dedicated migration bullet and attach smoke logs.
